scripts.check: node --check index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path'); function walk(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})) {const p=path.join(d,e.name); if(e.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if(p.endsWith('.js')) cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{stdio:'inherit'});}} walk('src')"
